claimChecks.claim: CircleIt is a Chrome extension and Claude Code/Codex plugin.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: a Chrome extension plus a Claude Code/Codex plugin

claimChecks.claim: CircleIt sends screenshots, comments, and metadata to the developer's running coding agent and reports status in the sender's browser.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: The screenshot, comment and meta information then goes straight to the agent

claimChecks.claim: CircleIt routes feedback to the right repository by matching the site address and can require approval before feedback reaches the agent.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: routed to the right repo by matching the site address, and you can require approval

claimChecks.claim: Velu's checker scores a documentation URL against the open Agent-Friendly Documentation Spec using the afdocs reference implementation.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: scores any docs URL against the open Agent-Friendly Documentation Spec (agentdocsspec.com), using its reference implementation, afdocs

claimChecks.claim: The described spec covers client-rendered pages, missing llms.txt or Markdown versions, soft 404s, and pages too large for an agent's context window.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: client-rendered pages, no llms.txt, no markdown versions, soft 404s, pages too big for a context window

claimChecks.claim: Velu's product page describes 23 checks across 7 categories.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: 23 checks across 7 categories, scored against an open standard
